Agent Program

Agent Rules & Earnings

Clear guidelines, benefits, and earning opportunities for every TTPRO agent.

👋 Agent Guidelines

Here are the rules and guidelines for all agents:

  • 💰 Earn ₱25–₱300 per qualified FTD.
  • 📊 FTD is based on deposits, valid betting, redeposits, and player win/loss performance.
  • 📈 Your earnings depend on player quality and activity.

🎁 Agent Benefits

  • 💎 Earn up to ₱300 per FTD.
  • 🔄 Unlimited salary requests.
  • 💵 Daily or weekly payouts.
  • 🕑 Data updates every 2 hours.
  • 👥 Minimum of 5 qualified players per request.

⚠️ Rules

  • ❌ No fake or duplicate accounts.
  • ❌ No duplicate IP addresses or devices.
  • ❌ No fraudulent activity.
  • ❌ No PVP or live games.
  • ✅ Only legitimate and qualified players will be counted.

📌 Important

Player performance affects your FTD value. Higher-quality and more active players may result in higher earnings.
